detail: Phase 4 of the init overhaul: sweep every init/doctor/find/check gap message into (what is known, then the exact next input), degrade the multi-service init bail to an honest exit-0 listing, teach doctor to report the zero-flag target plan instead of demanding a flag, and encode the invariant as the a_gap_is_always_phrased_as_the_next_input architecture test. Planned feature and message work, not a defect fix.
